Title: Azure AD admin roles for B2C are in public preview

Body.Content:
Welcome to the preview of new B2C Azure AD administrator roles for B2C tenants. The new roles are

  • B2C User Flow Administrator
  • B2C User Flow Attribute Administrator
  • B2C IEF Keyset Administrator
  • B2C IEF Policy Administrator

Delegating these roles allows robust management of B2C user flows (also known as built-in policies). For example, the B2C User Flow administrator, by creating or editing user flows, can change the html/CSS/javascript content of the user experience, change MFA requirements per user flow, change claims in the token and adjust session settings for all policies in the tenant. For more detailed information, see the documentation.
